requirements.desc: The integration precheck shall distinguish structurally authoritative test evidence from the test outcome verdict so a requirement failure alone does not prevent stale fingerprint classification.

When structurally authoritative test-execute and test-result-review artifacts carry the same valid repairFingerprint and it differs from the current material repair fingerprint, the integration gate shall classify the evidence as stale before returning a failed test outcome verdict.
requirements.note: R2: failed review evidence with a material fingerprint change is stale

requirements.desc: Authoritative stale evidence shall use the existing gate-owned recovery operation to invalidate stale downstream evidence and make flow-level test-execute the active step without semantic gate evaluation.
requirements.note: R3: the gate-owned recovery invalidates evidence and reactivates test-execute

requirements.desc: A successful stale recovery shall report the previous fingerprint, current fingerprint, invalidated artifact paths, and active step, and its observable artifact and lifecycle mutations shall complete as one owned recovery operation.
requirements.note: R4: a failed lifecycle mutation leaves stale artifacts available for retry

requirements.desc: Missing required inputs, malformed JSON or schema, invalid or inconsistent repairFingerprint values, unowned paths, invalid raw evidence, and placeholder-policy failures shall remain fail-closed structural trust failures with no stale recovery mutation.
requirements.note: R5: invalid fingerprint authority fails closed without a recovery mutation

requirements.desc: Failed test evidence whose repairFingerprint matches the current material repair fingerprint shall retain the existing test artifact validation failure and shall not rewind lifecycle state.
requirements.note: R6: unchanged failed evidence still fails after stale recovery is available

requirements.desc: Trusted current evidence shall continue to semantic integration gate evaluation, and the explicit rewind-test-evidence command shall retain its exact target guard, ExternalBlockedOutcome, material repair, and artifact ownership requirements.
requirements.note: R7: trusted current evidence and explicit rewind guard behavior remain intact

requirements.desc: Regression coverage shall exercise failed-but-authoritative stale evidence, malformed and inconsistent authority, unchanged failed evidence, successful recovery effects, trusted current evidence, and unchanged explicit rewind rejection behavior.
requirements.note: R8: failed authoritative evidence variants share one recovery contract

entries.reason: static test review found incomplete preservation coverage for recovery reporting and authority boundaries
entries.resolution: added invalidated-path assertions, malformed and inconsistent authority matrices, and focused rewind material-repair, ownership, lifecycle, and guard regressions

entries.reason: test review result recording exhausted its tooling attempts because the provider emitted duplicate findingId values
entries.resolution: no in-scope recovery was available; the persisted reviewAction is stop_as_blocker and the flow remains at test-review

entries.reason: the blocked review attempts exposed two remaining test coverage gaps after the first repair
entries.resolution: added the missing test-result-review case and asserted all four selected rewind authority tests plus the exact executed pass count

entries.reason: stale review convergence records were projected by phase after a changed review tree, so retry reset remained blocked despite new evidence
entries.resolution: made status and next-action resolve convergence actions against the current Git tree SHA; added regression coverage preserving same-tree exhaustion

entries.reason: included the typed repair invalidation records in the atomic stale recovery result while preserving staged artifact removal
preserved the lifecycle mutation error as the cause of a dedicated rollback failure instead of allowing cleanup errors to mask it
applied the canonical RepairEvidenceInvalidationPlan inside the staged recovery transaction and used its serialized audit records in the recovery result
R5 failed because integration trust accepted review artifact links that pointed outside the active spec-owned result path
entries.resolution: added exact ownership validation for result and raw evidence links before fingerprint staleness classification

entries.reason: R6 and R7 failed because repair fingerprint hashing treated Git staging and commit metadata changes as material content changes
entries.resolution: reduced canonical entry identity to path, rename source, mode, and content hash while retaining Git status metadata for audit output

entries.reason: test-result-review correctly rejected evidence after the manifest-publication repair changed product source following test execution
entries.resolution: completed integrity review against the exact source state that produced the artifact, then restored the repair so impl-review can perform its owned stale-evidence rewind

entries.reason: R6 and R7 remained stale because evidence writers stamped only the hash and did not persist the manifest that owns the immutable baseline
entries.resolution: the shared evidence writer now persists the authoritative repair fingerprint manifest before publishing each stamped evidence artifact

entries.reason: R7 nested regression did not execute because Node 22 propagates NODE_TEST_CONTEXT to child node --test processes and suppresses recursive test discovery
entries.resolution: kept every behavioral assertion unchanged and isolated the nested runner by removing only NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from its child environment

entries.reason: The shared help renderer exposes only a flow command's summary line, so the parked-resume no-discovery guarantee was absent from actual CLI help
entries.resolution: Moved the no-discovery guarantee into the resume command summary that the shared renderer preserves

entries.reason: User explicitly selected accept_risk_and_continue for unresolved acceptance risk.
entries.resolution: continue to final-regression with accepted risk

entries.reason: The shared active-flow pointer disappeared after acceptance-decision even though the worktree flow state and exact identity remained valid
entries.resolution: Restored the exact managed-worktree pointer with flow resume --parked and runId/spec/Issue guards
